overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Sharon Deyeso, Vice President of the Medford Lions Club, about the organization's history, global research impact, and local service projects. The discussion focused on upcoming scholarships, vision screenings, and the club's efforts to recruit youth through the Leo program.

items.title: Introduction and Guest Biography
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced Sharon Deyeso, a lifelong Medford resident and educator, who discussed her role as incoming president of the Medford Lions Club.

items.title: Overview of Lions International and Medford Lions
items.summary: Deyeso explained the relationship between the international foundation and local chapters, noting the organization's focus on eyesight, hearing, diabetes, and disaster aid.

items.title: Local Initiatives and Fundraising
items.summary: The Medford chapter holds annual events including a Turkey Raffle in November and specialized scholarships for students with vision or hearing impairments.

items.title: History and Impact of Lions Research
items.summary: The guest detailed how Lions-funded research identified incubator oxygen levels as a cause of infant blindness and discussed recent advancements in retinal chip technology.

items.title: Membership and Contact Information
items.summary: Deyeso provided contact information for the local chapter and encouraged interested residents to research the organization's global service projects online.

items.title: Local Presence and Eyeglass Donation
items.summary: The club maintains collection boxes for used eyeglasses and hearing aids at Medford City Hall and the Brookline Bank lobby in Medford Square.

items.title: Youth Programs and the Leo Club
items.summary: The Medford Lions plan to approach local schools to re-establish a Leo Club for students aged 13 to 18 to foster community service and leadership.

items.title: Vision Screenings and the iMobile
items.summary: The discussion covered the history of vision screenings in schools and the availability of the Lions 'iMobile' van for community eye testing events.

items.title: Scholarship Night Announcement
items.summary: Deyeso extended a public invitation to the upcoming Scholarship Night at the Medford V.A.W. to honor student recipient Rebecca Oliveira.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Show Information
items.summary: Petrella concluded the program by detailing where viewers can find replays, podcasts, and social media links for Medford Happenings.
